title: 90s Pre-Rendered Character CG
theme_prompt: Mid-90s PRE-RENDERED PROMOTIONAL CG character look, exactly like a Rare Ltd. Donkey Kong Country / Killer Instinct box-art render or a Silicon-Graphics-workstation cutscene bust — NOT a realtime game screenshot, a slow offline CG render. A single stylized CREATURE/ANIMAL-MASCOT BUST or friendly monster head-and-shoulders figure is SCULPTED INTO the top of the device housing as its dominant, character-forward feature — this is a character portrait fused with a media player, not a plain box. The bust reads as chunky, rounded, toylike geometry with smoothly gouraud-shaded facets (soft polygonal transitions, no crisp modern subdivision), glossy INJECTION-MOLDED-PLASTIC skin with tight specular hot-spots and long soft raytraced highlight streaks, faint environment-map sheen like an SGI render, and simple flat ambient-occlusion-style core shadows under brows/chin/jaw. Saturated primary-colour glossy plastics (reds, blues, warm ambers) against satin chrome trim. Rendered on a plain dark studio backdrop with a single soft key light, exactly like a mid-90s pack-in demo-disc character render — chunky, glossy, pre-rendered, warm, a little naive, unmistakably a CHARACTER, never abstract or geometric-only.

lighting.emissive_hint: a small glossy gem-like eye or chest jewel on the character catching a warm point-light glint
